Attendee.title: Attendee
Attendee.description: An individual participating in a meeting.

color.description: Tailwind color name assigned to the attendee

TimelineItem.title: TimelineItem
TimelineItem.description: A single spoken statement in the meeting transcript timeline.

relativeTime.description: Relative time elapsed since meeting start (e.g. MM:SS)

speakerId.description: The attendee ID of the speaker

Meeting.description: A complete logged meeting with attendees, real-time speech-to-text transcript, and AI summary.

aiSummary.description: The AI generated summary or action items list
